items.intro_words: Welcome by the School Board President
My name is Jude. I am in the second grade at Henry Ford School. Please join me in the Pledge of Allegiance.
Moving on. Are there any changes to the agenda?
Do we have a motion to approve the agenda?
So we will move on to the staff recognition.
So we are on to item six, the bond program consent items to approve.
All right, moving on to 7.1, which is a bond action item.
Okay, item 8.1, which I think is here for. So, John, did you want to go ahead and start?
We are on 11.1. Action item. This is the resolution of emergency relating to COVID 19.
We are on 11.1. Report from board members and superintendent.
All right, then. Other business suggested items for future agenda.
And then changes to the agenda, the board agenda, schedule.
Is there a motion to adjourn. In unison?
